title: Mandatory checkpoints belong at the last responsible moment

model.hazard: failure mode with first step at which it can irreversibly contaminate the endpoint
model.gate: checkpoint covering one or more hazards
model.validity: gate position must be at or before the earliest first-unsafe step among hazards it covers

theorem_contract: Under the declared nonnegative early-exposure cost, the minimum-cost valid placement is the latest safe position before the earliest covered hazard activates.
interpretation: Mandatory does not mean always visible.
A correctness barrier should appear immediately before the first operation that would make its omission consequential.
Placing a gate earlier than necessary creates avoidable cognitive friction.
Placing it later creates an invalid bypass.
boundary: Hazard activation steps are design annotations, not measured human cognitive timing.
